messages.text:
A few things broke in the game, and I'd like them all fixed:

1. The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0.
2. I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore.
3. I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate.
4. The game started beeping when I find a pair.

Keep the rest working, and please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed the four regressions:

- Best scores now update only when a game uses fewer moves; an unrecorded size shows **Best: none**.
- Arrow keys move focus within the same row or column and stop at board edges. Modified keys and Tab keep their browser behavior.
- Reduced-motion settings disable the card transition and win pulse.
- Matching pairs no longer play a tone; the game stays silent.

`git diff --check` passed. I did not run the test suites.

Key changes: [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60), [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:28), [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:49), [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:32), and [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:78).
